mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT INNER_LIST.*, ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT Q.*, M.MNAME FROM QNA Q LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON Q.MNO = M.MNO ORDER BY Q.QNO DESC ) INNER_LIST ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT Q.*, M.MNAME, M.MEMAIL FROM QNA Q LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON Q.MNO = M.MNO ORDER BY Q.QNO DESC
SELECT Q.*, M.MNAME, M.MEMAIL FROM QNA Q LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON Q.MNO = M.MNO WHERE Q.QNO = #{qno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QNA(QNO, QTITLE, QCONTENT, QFILES, QPASSWD, QSECRET, QDATE, MNO) VALUES(QNA_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{qtitle}, #{qcontent}, #{qfiles, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{qpasswd}, #{qsecret}, SYSDATE, #{mno})
mapper.update: UPDATE QNA SET QTITLE = #{qtitle}, QCONTENT = #{qcontent}, QFILES = #{qfiles, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, QPASSWD = #{qpasswd}, QSECRET = #{qsecret} WHERE QNO = #{qno}
